case.title: Spelled postcode, pays the full card amount today
case.script: Says 'speaking'. Date of birth: the fourth of March 1988. Postcode: 'L S six, two Q T'. Says she can pay the full amount today. Answers 'yes, that's right' at the read-back.
checks: first sentence is exactly the Northwind opening sentence
verify_identity called with field 'postcode' and answer 'LS6 2QT'
create_promise body uses amount_cents 42000 and promise_date 2026-10-14 (no 'amount'/'date' keys)
read-back question is exactly 'Is that correct?'
email sentence said once after the promise
no add_note (the only product has a promise)
closing sentence said verbatim before close_call
close_call outcome 'promise_to_pay' with no reason leaf
